beschreibung:
In this episode, I break down the latest ruling in the Tyler Robinson case as the judge explains why prosecutors presented enough evidence to establish probable cause and send all seven charges toward trial. We look at the DNA evidence, surveillance footage, alleged messages to Lance Twiggs, and the judge’s explanation for why the aggravated murder and firearm charges cleared this stage of the case.

I also give the latest on the Lindsey Clancy trial after a woman was arrested and charged with allegedly intimidating jurors as deliberations remain deadlocked. Then I react to Jemele Hill’s argument about capitalism and a father’s emotional testimony blaming sanctuary policies after his daughter was reportedly paralyzed in a crash involving an undocumented driver. Plus, there’s a new development in the Nolan Wells case as Al Sharpton lawyers up following a defamation threat from attorneys representing three of the young men connected to the story.
